meta.name: bar-mega
meta.purpose: Ratchet for the three-feature implementation (Group A cleanup, Group B Agent Reputation, Group C Agent Registry). A green bar means every in-scope item is implemented and tested, the full pre-existing suite is green with no regressions, all contract checks pass after their generate steps, lint and build are clean, every changed file is within the allowlist, the sibling and reference repos are untouched, and the planning docs exist and cite real files.
meta.standards: zero slop; no em or en dashes; no fabricated findings or metrics; plain language

A.target: all IN SCOPE items implemented and tested; OUT OF SCOPE items documented only

B.title: Agent Reputation
B.target: all IN SCOPE items implemented and tested; depends on nothing new

items.summary: drizzle/0018_agent_reputation.sql: agent_reputation_events, agent_reputation_snapshots, agent_reputation_receipts; Postgres-only, idempotent, org-scoped, are_/ars_/arr_ id prefixes

items.test: reputation-routes.test.js (8): snapshot/computed/404, events, recompute, receipt, leaderboard, real-crypto verify ok/tamper/missing
leaderboard covered in reputation-routes.test.js; summary route implemented read-only

items.test: sdk unit tests + contract test; sdk:count reconciled

C.title: Agent Registry
C.target: all IN SCOPE items implemented and tested; depends on B for the trust metric; delegates to the capability runtime

items.summary: Every registry invocation delegates to the existing guard/action/capability seams; risk from RISK_SCORE_MAP + getPredictiveRisk clamped 0-100; no reimplemented HTTP/guard/action/outcome

Registered agent defined as external owned delegatable provider (endpoint, auth_type incl x402 metadata, risk_class, default budget, status) grouping capabilities; distinct noun/prefix from derived agents; reconciled with swarm/pairings/connections

drizzle/0019_agent_registry.sql (registered_agents, registered_agent_capabilities, agent_invocations referencing action_id); repository + lib + routes POST/GET /api/agents/registry, GET/PATCH .../[id], capability subroutes, POST /api/agents/invoke delegating to the capability runtime + guard + action; x402/auth metadata only, no settlement
items.test: route tests; invoke blocks on guard block; SSRF rejects loopback; cross-org returns not-found

items.summary: Extract a shared invokeGovernedCapability() from the capability invoke route so both routes share it
items.reason: refactors an existing hot-path route; default is to compose existing seams; only build if the user approves, which adds the invoke route to the allowlist

items.summary: Node + Python SDK methods (register/list/get/update/addCapability/listCapabilities/invoke); minimal dashboard under app/agents/registry/ (list, detail with capabilities + reputation trust metric from B, invocation history, register form) reusing fleet/table/card components; docs; tests
items.test: repository/lib/route tests; component test for dashboard; sdk:count reconciled

test_full_suite.note: full suite only; targeted runs miss regressions in unrelated files

build.target: clean exit 0 (required for any app/** change)

openapi_check.command: npm run openapi:generate && npm run openapi:check
openapi_check.target: no drift; reputation routes are experimental (inventory only), registry routes under /api/agents are experimental (inventory only), so the stable OpenAPI spec should be unchanged

api_inventory_check.command: npm run api:inventory:generate && npm run api:inventory:check

route_sql_check.target: no new route.js with direct SQL; no per-file SQL increase vs baseline

docs_check.target: markdown links resolve; Next.js major consistent

version_sync_check.target: platform and both SDKs share one version

sdk_count.target: manual reconciliation aid (not a CI gate); cited counts updated across the SDK checklist surfaces after B5 and C4

allowlist_only.target: every changed file is within the SPEC-mega.md allowlist

no_git_add_all.target: commits stage explicit paths only; never git add -A

import_only_modules_unchanged.target: guard.js, predictive-risk.js, capability-invoke.js, capability-runtime.js, integrity/**, signing-keys.repository.js, actions.repository.js, webhooks.js are not modified (unless the C3 shared-helper extraction is user-approved)

no_new_crypto_dependency.target: reputation receipts use Ed25519 via node:crypto only; package.json crypto deps unchanged

planning_docs_present.target: SPEC-mega.md, docs/absorbed-projects.md, bar-mega.json present and citing real files

adversarial_break_inputs: malformed reputation event (missing required fields, bad event_type)
cross-org reputation/registry lookup returns not-found, never another org's data
missing fields on register and invoke return clean validation errors
blocked invocation records a blocked action and does not execute
oversized invocation payload handled without crashing
private or loopback registry endpoint rejected by the inherited capability runtime SSRF defense
